description.value: Once per day, the jackanapes may make an eerie noise that affects all enemies within a 30-foot radius of the jackanapes must pass a Will save (DC 23) or be inflicted with Berserk status for 1d4 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 7th level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 29).

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 7th level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 29).

description.value: Sting—injury; save Fort DC 23; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Dex; cure 1 save. The save DC is Constitution-based, and includes a +2 racial bonus.

effect: Sting injury: [[1d2]] Dexterity damage once per round for six rounds.

description.value: The jackanapes can always act in the surprise round even if it fails to make a Perception roll to notice a foe, but it is still considered flat-footed until it takes an action. In addition, it receives a bonus on initiative checks equal to it Wisdom modifier.
Jackanapes are just plain dark creatures, and they tend to blend into dark surroundings easier. In darkness and low-light, jackanapes gain a +4 circumstance bonus to Stealth.
